notes.title: AutoClicker?
notes.notes:
With the current Update you can now decide if you want to see People who use AutClickers or not.
Everyone who uses an AutoClicker you are welcome and you can keep doing so!
From now on you are also tracked by our Rankings and can compare your Progress to everyone else.

But if you dont wish to see AutoClickers in the Rankings because you are playing the Game without and only want to compare your Progress to those also not using one you can still do so!

We added a new Toggle to the Global-Rankings UI that allows you to hide or show People with AutoClickers.

We hope everyone enjoys these changes!

Let us know what you think.

notes.title: CoinBlock Clicker Idle Update
notes.notes:
The Update includes the following:

[h3]Idle Buffs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buffed all Tubes so they all transport more Coins each Cycle which increases the base Idle Value by a Bit.
[*] The first IdleGame has an increased Idle-Coin Value from 2 to 3 And its Price is reduced from 75k to 30k with its Price Multiplier reduced from 3 to 2.
[*] Added the Possibility to upgrade each IdleGame. Clicking on one in the Idle UI opens a small Upgrade-Window. Upgrading IdleGames always costs more than purchasing that IdleGame in the Shop!
[/list]
[h3]New Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new Autoclicker Special Upgrade.
[/list]
[h3]General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Quest "Collect Items" has been buffed. You no longer need to collect as many as before to get the Reward.
[*] The Quest "Catch Wingcoins" has been buffed. You no longer need to collect as many as before to get the Reward.
[*] Decreased the Clicks needed to gain one Ticket from 4750 to 4000. This will increase the Tickets-Spawnrate.
[*] Removed the possibility to Trash IdleGames as the IdleGame Upgrade UI takes that Place.
[/list]
[h3]Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the new Tundra Music Track to the Tundra Prestige-World.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Wingcoin spawning was doubled whenever a prestige was done.
[/list]

Take note that the IdleGame Price changes only become visible when you Prestige your Game or play in a new Savefile since the Prices are saved to your Savefile!

We hope you enjoy this first CoinBlock Update!

notes.title: After many Months of work we can finally present: CoinBlock Clicker
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730671/aacdaca1695b96036b9a76da7e293c0ea8ba5ce9.png[/img]

After hard Work and Dedication we can finally and proudly present to you CoinBlock Clicker on Steam!
We hope you enjoy this little Clicker Game as much as we do making it. We are already planning Updates for the Game and will be looking forward to seeing you play what we created!

Since we did not decide to have this Game for Free you can expect many Content Updates. If you want to contribute to the development of the Game you can join our Discord and help us fix Bugs and even give us new Ideas. All Community Ideas are welcome!
